title: kv-cache: improved eviction/defrag heuristics to reduce fragmentation and spillover
author: Samira Patel
description: Context: We continue to see production KV cache memory pressure and increased fragmentation on long-running hosts serving a mix of short/long-context workloads. This PR improves eviction and defragmentation heuristics to reduce spillover to host memory and lower tail latency when the cache approaches capacity. Motivation: Previous eviction policy (LRU by chunk) left many small free fragments that prevented large contiguous allocations, causing paging/spillover even though aggregate free memory existed. This made scheduling and batching unstable for longer contexts and increased CPU overhead when falling back to disk-backed spill files. Goals: (1) reduce measurable fragmentation, (2) avoid unnecessary spillover under normal load, (3) keep eviction cost bounded and compatible with existing green-thread scheduler. Summary of changes: - Add a compacting defragmentation pass that runs opportunistically during low-CPU windows and before large allocations. The pass is incremental and bounded (max 5ms per invocation) to avoid SLO regressions. - Introduce a dual-queue eviction policy: hot (recently accessed) vs cold (low access frequency). Eviction prefers cold contiguous regions to decrease fragmentation. - Implement a spillover-aware allocator that attempts coalescing of adjacent free fragments before falling back to spill files; added heuristics to prefer preserving prefix KV blocks for streaming workloads. - Track fragment metadata with a lightweight 64-bit header per fragment (size + LRU bucket + generation) and a periodic sampler to estimate fragmentation ratio without full scans. - Add new metrics: kv.cache.fragmentation_ratio, kv.cache.coalesce_attempts, kv.cache.defrag_time_ms, kv.cache.spillover_fallbacks. - Improve tests, add targeted unit tests and an integration bench that simulates mixed short/long contexts with realistic access patterns. Benchmarks: - Microbenchmark on p4d.24xlarge equivalent: average allocation success without spillover improved from 87% -> 98% under mixed workload. - 95th token-latency for long-context requests reduced by ~22% in canary cluster (N=3), and end-to-end spillover events dropped 3x over 48h. - Defrag pass observed median CPU time ~0.8ms and 99th < 4.7ms with configured 5ms cap. Rollout plan: - Deploy as staged rollout 5% -> 25% -> 100% on Dedicated cluster for 48h windows; monitoring on new metrics and latency/throughput. - Feature gate (runtime flag) to disable defrag for sensitive customers. Compatibility: - Backwards compatible with existing checkpoint/serialization format; added fragment header version check for on-disk spill files. - No changes to external API. Testing: - Unit tests for allocator/coalesce/eviction (new tests added). - Integration stress test that reproducibly triggered previous spillover condition no longer triggers on bench. - CI: lint/build/unit/integration all green after two reruns (intermittent network flake initially). Breaking changes: none. Related: builds on prior PRs that addressed kv-cache paging and spillover (see ENG-1842, ENG-1977). Linked support ticket SUP-987 reports a customer-facing incident that motivated the canary workload. Implementation notes: - Defrag pass leverages runtime scheduling hooks to yield frequently; we tuned the batch size and cap in this PR to avoid head-of-line blocking. - The eviction dual-queue is lock-free for hot path reads and uses a short critical section on eviction to update metadata. - Spillover allocator is conservative: it will only attempt coalesce if estimated cost < spill threshold to avoid CPU amplification. Requests/next steps: - Ops requested a dashboard tile for kv.cache.spillover_fallbacks by region and instance type. - Product requested an opt-out config for legacy workloads that rely on previous allocation layout. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration bench - [x] Metrics and dashboards wiring - [x] Docs for runtime feature flag - [x] Staged rollout plan Commits: "kv: add defrag pass and fragment metadata header", "kv: dual-queue eviction policy", "kv: spillover-aware allocator and coalesce heuristics", "kv: add metrics and tests", "docs: runtime flag and rollout notes"
